docs.title: NodeMT5 SDK
docs.text: Welcome to the NodeMT5 SDK documentation. This high-performance Node.js and TypeScript library connects directly to MetaTrader 5 servers to execute trades, manage open positions, query account balance and margin, and stream real-time price quotes.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• TypeScript Native: Full typing support for compile-time safety across all requests, orders, and market events.
  • Event-Driven Streaming: Real-time tick quotes and market depth via reactive callbacks and EventEmitter.
  • Order Execution: Complete MT5 trade operations including market orders, pending orders, and partial closes.
  • Async/Await API: Idiomatic modern JavaScript Promises for clean asynchronous workflows.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
graph TD
    A[Node.js / TS Application] -->|Non-blocking Socket| B[MT5Client]
    B -->|Encrypted Protocol| C[MetaTrader 5 Server]
    C -->|Price Feeds| B
    C -->|Execution Confirmations| B
    B -->|Async Events| A

docs.title: Quick Installation
docs.text:
npm install @metarpc/nodemt5

Or with Yarn / pnpm:

yarn add @metarpc/nodemt5
# or
pnpm add @metarpc/nodemt5

Next, check out the Getting Started guide to build your first trading script.

docs.title: Account Information
docs.text: Inspect account summary, margin, leverage, and position history.

docs.title: Fetching Account Balance
docs.text:
const acc = await client.getAccountInfo();
console.log('Login:', acc.login);
console.log('Balance:', acc.balance);
console.log('Equity:', acc.equity);
console.log('Free Margin:', acc.freeMargin);
console.log('Leverage: 1:' + acc.leverage);

docs.title: Active Positions
docs.text:
const positions = await client.getPositions();
for (const pos of positions) {
  console.log(`#${pos.ticket} ${pos.symbol} ${pos.type} vol:${pos.volume} P/L:${pos.profit}`);
}

docs.title: Connection & Authentication
docs.text: Managing connections and sessions with MetaTrader 5.

docs.title: Basic Connection
docs.text:
import { MT5Client } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

const client = new MT5Client('mt5demo.broker.com', 443);
await client.connect(12345678, 'investor_or_master_password');

docs.title: Session Management & Auto-Reconnect
docs.text:
client.on('disconnected', async (reason) => {
  console.warn('Disconnected:', reason);
  console.log('Reconnecting in 5 seconds...');
  setTimeout(() => client.connect(12345678, 'password'), 5000);
});

docs.title: Graceful Shutdown
docs.text:
process.on('SIGINT', () => {
  console.log('Shutting down...');
  client.disconnect();
  process.exit(0);
});

docs.title: Getting Started with NodeMT5
docs.text: This guide shows you how to install NodeMT5, authenticate with an MT5 server, and place your first trade.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Node.js 18.0+
  • MT5 Account credentials (Host, Port, Login ID, Password)

docs.title: Quick Example
docs.text:
Create a file named quickstart.ts:

import { MT5Client } from '@metarpc/nodemt5';

async function main() {
  const client = new MT5Client('mt5.broker.com', 443);

  // Authenticate
  console.log('Connecting to MT5...');
  await client.connect(12345678, 'your_password');
  console.log('Connected!');

  // Fetch account overview
  const account = await client.getAccountInfo();
  console.log(`Account Balance: ${account.balance} ${account.currency}`);
  console.log(`Leverage: 1:${account.leverage}`);

  // Subscribe to live EURUSD ticks
  await client.subscribeQuotes(['EURUSD'], (quote) => {
    console.log(`[EURUSD] Bid: ${quote.bid} | Ask: ${quote.ask}`);
  });

  // Open a 0.01 lot Buy order
  const order = await client.orderSend({
    symbol: 'EURUSD',
    action: 'BUY',
    volume: 0.01,
    comment: 'NodeMT5 Quickstart'
  });

  console.log(`Order placed! Ticket: #${order.ticket}`);
}

main().catch(console.error);

Run with ts-node or compile with tsc:

npx ts-node quickstart.ts

docs.title: Quotes & Market Data
docs.text: Stream real-time prices and fetch historical candle bars.

docs.title: Real-Time Tick Streaming
docs.text:
await client.subscribeQuotes(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'XAUUSD'], (quote) => {
  console.log(`Symbol: ${quote.symbol} | Bid: ${quote.bid} | Ask: ${quote.ask}`);
});

docs.title: Historical Candlesticks (OHLCV)
docs.text:
const bars = await client.getHistoricalBars({
  symbol: 'EURUSD',
  timeframe: 'H1',
  count: 100
});

for (const bar of bars) {
  console.log(`${new Date(bar.time * 1000).toISOString()} Open: ${bar.open} High: ${bar.high} Low: ${bar.low} Close: ${bar.close}`);
}

docs.title: Trading & Orders
docs.text: Execute market orders, pending orders, and manage positions.

docs.title: Market Orders
docs.text:
const buyResult = await client.orderSend({
  symbol: 'EURUSD',
  action: 'BUY',
  volume: 0.1,
  slippage: 10,
  comment: 'Market Buy'
});
console.log('Opened Ticket:', buyResult.ticket);

docs.title: Modifying Stop Loss & Take Profit
docs.text:
await client.orderModify({
  ticket: buyResult.ticket,
  stopLoss: 1.0800,
  takeProfit: 1.0950
});

docs.title: Closing Positions
docs.text:
await client.orderClose({
  ticket: buyResult.ticket,
  volume: 0.1
});
